title: Exact decomposition algorithms for the student clustering problem: code and data
description:
Code and data accompanying the paper Exact decomposition algorithms for the student clustering problem (European Journal of Operational Research, forthcoming).

Contains the two exact decomposition algorithms for the Student Clustering Problem — a single-tree branch-and-check scheme using combinatorial (no-good) cuts and a branch-and-Benders-cut method — the monolithic MILP baseline, the heterogeneous-cost experiment, and the opening-cost vectors generated for that experiment.

The 121 benchmark instances are third-party data and are not redistributed here; see the README for their source. Requires Julia 1.12.5 with JuMP and CPLEX.jl, and IBM ILOG CPLEX 22.1.1 (commercial licence).
